      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "Tariffs and Teeth",
      "goal": "Survive the initial resource loop by identifying the hidden taxes on basic survival gear and finding a loophole in the local economy.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "From immediate physical survival to economic viability in a rigged system.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Rhea survived the drop but is starving and broke.",
        "to_next": "Having secured a baseline, Rhea attracts the attention of others trapped in the same loop."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 3,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 6
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Cost of Breathing",
          "intent": "Rhea attempts to gather basic resources but encounters the local tariff mechanics that drain stamina and HP.",
          "section_role": "setup",
          "status": "locked",
          "target_scene_count": 2,
          "end_condition": "Rhea hits critical stamina levels and realizes standard gathering will bankrupt her HP before nightfall.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "progression",
              "summary": "Rhea descends from the Crater Ridge into a sparse, ash-choked forest to find water or food. She attempts to harvest a glowing, fruit-like fungus from a petrified tree, but the System immediately deducts a 'Gathering Tax' from her Stamina, causing a sharp physical backlash.",
              "outcome": "Rhea successfully harvests one piece of fungus but loses a disproportionate amount of Stamina to a System tax, leaving her winded and cautious.",
              "characters": [
                "char_rhea"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Crater Ridge",
              "location_end_label": "Petrified Ashwood",
              "location_start": "Walking along the jagged upper lip of the impact crater.",
              "location_end": "At the base of a petrified tree in an ash-choked forest.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Rhea leaves the glassy edge of the impact crater behind, her boots crunching down a steep incline into a valley of pale, petrified trees.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "glassy crater edge",
                "steep ash incline",
                "pale petrified trees"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "transition_out_text": "Clutching the glowing fungus to her chest, Rhea leans heavily against the petrified bark, her lungs burning as the System notification flashes its stamina deduction.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "glowing fungus",
                "petrified bark",
                "flashing stamina notification"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "progression",
              "summary": "Desperate to offset the stamina loss, Rhea tries to gather loose branches for a fire and scavenge more fungus, but every interaction triggers a micro-tax. The compounding stamina drain begins eating into her HP, forcing her to stop before she kills herself through basic survival tasks.",
              "outcome": "Rhea stops gathering entirely as her HP drops, realizing the System's economy is rigged to kill anyone who plays by the standard rules.",
              "characters": [
                "char_rhea"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Petrified Ashwood",
              "location_end_label": "Ashwood Riverbed",
              "location_start": "At the base of a petrified tree in an ash-choked forest.",
              "location_end": "Slumped against a jagged boulder near a dry riverbed.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Pushing off the petrified bark, Rhea stumbles deeper into the pale forest, her eyes scanning the ground for loose branches that might not trigger the System's predatory ledger.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "petrified bark",
                "pale forest floor",
                "loose gray branches"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "transition_out_text": "Rhea collapses against a jagged boulder by the dry riverbed, watching her health bar tick downward as the realization of the rigged economy sets in.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "jagged boulder",
                "dry riverbed",
                "ticking health bar"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3",
              "end_condition_echo": "Rhea hits critical stamina levels and realizes standard gathering will bankrupt her HP before nightfall."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Physics vs. The System",
          "intent": "Rhea observes local mob behavior and loot drop rules, spotting a discrepancy between physics and System taxation.",
          "section_role": "action",
          "status": "draftable",
          "target_scene_count": 2,
          "end_condition": "Rhea successfully forces a mob to drop untaxed raw materials by exploiting a collision between environmental damage and loot generation.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "progression",
              "summary": "Rhea observes a low-level mob—a brittle, ash-crusted scavenger—foraging in the dry riverbed. She notices that when the creature accidentally knocks a loose branch off a petrified tree, the branch drops as a physical object without triggering a System tax notification, unlike when she tried to harvest it directly.",
              "outcome": "Rhea identifies that environmental physics interactions bypass the System's gathering tax, formulating a plan to use the mob to harvest for her.",
              "characters": [
                "char_rhea"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Ashwood Riverbed",
              "location_end_label": "Ashwood Riverbed",
              "location_start": "Slumped against a jagged boulder near a dry riverbed.",
              "location_end": "Crouched behind a petrified root overlooking a shallow depression.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Pushing herself up from the jagged boulder, Rhea creeps along the edge of the dry riverbed, drawn by the sound of scraping claws.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "jagged boulder",
                "dry riverbed",
                "scraping claws"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "transition_out_text": "Rhea ducks behind a thick, petrified root, her eyes locked on the fallen branch and the absence of a flashing blue tax penalty.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "petrified root",
                "fallen branch",
                "ash-crusted scavenger"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "action",
              "summary": "Rhea uses her makeshift masonry bludgeon to herd the ash-crusted scavenger into a cluster of glowing fungus and brittle branches. Instead of attacking the mob directly, she strikes the petrified trees, causing heavy debris to fall and crush the creature while simultaneously knocking loose raw materials.",
              "outcome": "Rhea successfully forces a mob to drop untaxed raw materials by exploiting a collision between environmental damage and loot generation.",
              "characters": [
                "char_rhea"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Ashwood Riverbed",
              "location_end_label": "Ashwood Riverbed",
              "location_start": "Crouched behind a petrified root overlooking a shallow depression.",
              "location_end": "Standing over the crushed remains of the scavenger amidst a pile of untaxed loot.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Gripping her heavy masonry bludgeon, Rhea steps out from behind the petrified root and hurls a loose stone to startle the scavenger toward the tree line.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "heavy masonry bludgeon",
                "petrified root",
                "loose stone"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "transition_out_text": "Panting heavily, Rhea stands over the crushed scavenger, staring down at the pile of glowing fungus and splintered wood that the System registers as untaxed environmental debris.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "crushed scavenger",
                "glowing fungus",
                "splintered wood"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5",
              "end_condition_echo": "Rhea successfully forces a mob to drop untaxed raw materials by exploiting a collision between environmental damage and loot generation."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
